limits: Synthetic reduced-order dynamics and provisional geometry/contact parameters
Narrow front-bucket training distribution; challenges explicitly label extrapolation
Endpoint IK is not native trajectory or collision-path validation
Limited-budget oracle is search, not learned inference or an optimality bound
No physical, camera, gripper or board-suction validation
Training seeds share held-out layouts; uncertainty and seed variability are reported separately
Center/edge U/V intervention changes trajectory, endpoint reachability and compliant response together; it does not isolate suspension effects
Distance challenge groups independently sample small board-pose variations; descriptive sampled comparison, not a paired causal distance experiment
Raw stdout challenge progress uses generic per-attempt summaries: its repeated-noise intervals are not inference-quality; published clustered challenge-summary/report intervals are authoritative
Post-study finite-search/fixed controls are diagnostics, not policy inference; zero successes do not establish impossibility

Noise cohort is closer: mean forward distance 207.1 mm and 2/24 beyond 280 mm, versus shared test 241.2 mm and 16/48; its high capture rate is not overall held-out performance. Manifest was not resampled.
